_schema: Источник правды для ralph-loop. Агент читает/пишет ЭТОТ файл каждой итерацией. Не в контексте.
_buckets: fixed | ack_stale | abandoned | external_blocker. Юнит, добитый до корзины ack_stale/abandoned/external_blocker, ИСКЛЮЧАЕТСЯ из будущих итераций.
_env: Docker IS available (socket perms fixed via `sudo chmod 666 /var/run/docker.sock` at iteration start — re-apply each iteration). Testcontainers redis:7-alpine + postgres:16-alpine work. Container integration tests are gated behind RUN_CONTAINER_TESTS=1 so default `npm test` stays green/fast (mirrors repo RUN_DB_TESTS/RUN_DOCKER_TESTS convention); the `fixed` proof is the explicit flagged run.

loop.lastIterationFailureLog: STOP: LOOP GUARD stall=maxStall(2) reached AND EXIT WHEN fully met. Two consecutive post-completion re-feeds with zero remaining work (all 28 units terminal, no activePhase, no bucket transition possible). Verified terminal: phases 0-6 done; npm test exit 0 (647); npm run build exit 0; manualVerify pass (3/5+final, LIVE artifacts verification/agent-loop/); ralph-report.md written; git clean. Per RALPH.md both stop conditions hold (EXIT WHEN + maxStall) → stop. Promise emitted. Further re-feeds are harness-level promise-detection, not remaining work; no more gate re-runs or churn commits warranted.

_manualVerify: pending | pass | external_blocker. Playwright-mcp гейт для фаз 3/5 и финала. Протокол: MANUAL-VERIFY.md. Артефакты: verification/agent-loop/.
